thread:
emma_pmm: Quick sync — final pass on the competitive battlecard before the webinar on Mon. Need 2 short pull-quotes for the sales one-pager and a single-line headline variant. Can people drop ideas here by EOD? :hourglass: 

matt_sales: 👍 I'll take a stab at two customer-facing quotes. Need the priority competitor list again (cloud AI platforms vs LLM APIs vs infra vendors)?
deepa_marketing: Priority: 1) Cloud AI platforms (managed endpoints + price pressure), 2) LLM API providers (simplicity & breadth), 3) Inference infra vendors (self-host ops + cost control). Use different tilt per audience.

emma_pmm: Exactly. For webinar CTA we want clarity: "predictable inference economics" + "same API across hosted/dedicated/private" — short, bold. Also want one line that calls out fallback/resilience as a product differentiator.

alan_prod: Copy suggestions: 
- Headline A: "Inference that keeps your app fast and predictable, not your costs."
- Headline B: "One API. Any deployment. Enterprise SLAs."

carla_research: From benchmarks: latency tail and unit cost numbers beat top managed endpoints in our 1k-user synthetic test — but keep numbers out of the battlecard (use slides). For sales quotes: "Cut per-token cost by half without trading latency on typical chat workloads." Can be shortened.
sanjay_design: I pushed a two-column layout to the doc: https://docs.google.com/our-battlecard-draft please add your final lines in the <Pull Quotes> box. I can iterate visuals after quotes land. :paintbrush:

matt_sales: Quick quote candidates (short):
- "Half the cost of managed endpoints for production chat, with SLA-backed latency."
- "Same API from hosted to on-prem — ship once, run anywhere."
Pick one, or we A/B test in outreach.

emma_pmm: Nice. Second quote needs to antagonize infra vendors without being mean — something like: "Get self-host economics without building your own stack." Thoughts?

carla_research: That lands. Short variant: "Self-host economics, zero-infra build."

deepa_marketing: For the buyer-facing headline options: my order preference B > A > a more tactical one: "Optimize latency, cost, and reliability for real traffic."

alan_prod: For competitor callouts (one-liner each):
```
- Cloud AI platforms: easiest to start, harder to predict costs at scale.
- LLM APIs: broad model access, limited deployment control.
- Infra vendors: full control but heavy ops and slow time-to-value.
```
Keep these tight and in voice.

emma_pmm: Great. Action items before EOD:
- @matt_sales finalize one HQ quote + one outreach variant (matt).
- @deepa_marketing pick headline and approve micro-copy (deepa).
- @sanjay_design update visual and export PNGs for slide deck (sanjay).
- @alan_prod confirm the competitor one-liners and add a fallback sentence on routing/fallback tech (alan).
- @carla_research add a single battlecard footnote: "based on Redwood internal 1000-user synth test, see deck" (carla).

ops_bot: Webinar event created: webinar-redwood-inference-2026-03-25. Slides folder: /events/webinar-2026-03-25/slides (owner: emma_pmm).

matt_sales: I'll drop final quotes in the doc in 30m.

deepa_marketing: I'll lock headline and microcopy; will post final here once done.

emma_pmm: Thanks all — if we get these in, I'll hand to enablement for the sales pack. Quick reminder: keep public-facing language non-technical but bring the tech proof into the deck. :sparkles:
